07 — Questions

Good to know

Can I order a custom size?

Yes. Custom-made sofas and furniture is what we do. Send us your measurements or a photo of your room on WhatsApp.

How do I get a price?

Price depends on size, fabric and finish, so we confirm it with you on WhatsApp once we know what you want.

Can I choose the fabric and colour?

Yes. Pick leather, velvet or fabric and tell us the colour. Use the quote builder above to put it into one message.

Where can I find you?

Doddenahalli, Yerappanahalli, Karnataka 560077. Open the Maps link at the bottom of this page, and message us before you visit.
